channel.title: Uganda - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Uganda, every source cited.

item.title: Uganda: epilepsy drug mix-up kills child, hospitalises 16
item.description: Health workers in Butebo district administered carbamazepine instead of deworming medicine during a child outreach.

item.title: Jumia Uganda launches Black Friday deals up to 80% off
item.description: The online marketplace offers discounts on electronics, appliances, and fashion from October 30 to November 30.

item.title: Uganda's EAC trade deficit hits $809 million
item.description: Imports from Kenya and Tanzania far outstripped Uganda's exports in August 2026, widening the regional trade gap.

item.title: Uganda screens over 30,000 buildings for earthquake safety
item.description: The National Building Review Board is updating seismic risk maps and construction standards to protect communities.

item.title: Museveni urges church to champion wealth creation
item.description: President Museveni's message at the 141st Bishop Hannington commemoration stressed combining spiritual guidance with practical efforts to improve livelihoods.
